# Lynk-X

> Lynk-X is an all-in-one event discovery, ticketing and community platform built for Sub-Saharan Africa and global event-goers. It pairs zero-friction mobile ticketing with automated private event forums, eliminating fragmented WhatsApp groups and manual attendee spreadsheets.

## Core Products & Roles

- [For Organizers](https://lynk-x.app/for/organizers): Event creation, automated ticketing tiers, instant payouts, gate check-in scanners and attendee broadcast forums in a single dashboard.
- [For Attendees](https://lynk-x.app/for/attendees): Progressive Web App (PWA) for event discovery, instant checkout, ticket management and private event forums with live chat and shared media walls. No app store download required.
- [For Sponsors & Advertisers](https://lynk-x.app/for/ad-sponsors): Targeted sponsor placements and brand campaigns reaching verified event attendees directly inside event forums with automatic creative optimization.

## Key Capabilities

- **Frictionless Ticketing**: Multiple ticket tiers, instant M-Pesa STK push, credit/debit cards, reservation countdown timers and secure QR code gate redemption.
- **Private Event Forums**: Every ticket automatically unlocks a private event forum containing organizer announcements, attendee live chat and a shared media wall.
- **Zero App Barrier**: Built as a Progressive Web App (PWA) running seamlessly across iOS, Android and desktop browsers without requiring app store installation.
- **Brand Sponsorships**: Native in-forum sponsor banners and campaign slots delivering targeted reach to verified ticket holders.
